welcome: A safer neighborhood starts with you.
intro: Spot standing water. Share a report. Follow the cleanup. Together, we can reduce mosquito breeding risks.
anonymous: No account needed. Your precise location stays private.
mapIntro: Explore reported conditions and community cleanup progress.
collective: Every report is a step toward a safer community.
collectiveBody: From a small water container to a blocked drain, your observations help cleanup teams act where they are needed.
how: A little action goes a long way
how1Body: Look for water collecting in containers, drains or open spaces.
how2Body: Add a photo and location. Reporting takes about a minute.
how3Body: Track human review, cleanup and proof of resolution.
privacyShort: Public pins show an approximate area. Exact GPS and unreviewed photos stay private.
mapUnavailable: Map unavailable. The report list is still available.
reportIntro: Share a suspected breeding condition. A person will review your report.
photoHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP · Up to 8 MB. Avoid faces, license plates and private information.
savedDraft: Saved on this device. You can return in My reports.
gpsDenied: Location unavailable. Enter coordinates or adjust the pin below.
locationHelp: Only authorized reviewers can see your precise pin. Public location is approximate.
locationPlaceholder: A landmark that helps the cleanup team
descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the water accumulation. Please avoid names, phone numbers and exact addresses.
reviewBody: Your report will be reviewed by a person. It does not confirm the presence of dengue or Aedes mosquitoes.
consent: I agree to share this photo and precise location for review and cleanup coordination. An approximate area and privacy-reviewed evidence may be public.
consentVersion: Consent version 2026-10-v1. Optional AI and SMS processing are disabled.
offlineSaved: Saved offline. Reconnect and use My reports to sync.
photoRequired: Add a valid photo smaller than 8 MB.
locationInvalid: Choose a location within the configured demo area (23.725–23.760 N, 90.360–90.420 E).
duplicateBody: Someone may have already reported this condition. You can follow the existing report or submit a separate observation.
success: Thank you for looking out for your community.
successBody: Your report is in the review queue. Save your private tracking credential to manage your report.
keepToken: Keep this credential private. The public QR never includes it.
approximate: Approximate public location · 150 m privacy grid
awaitingPrivacy: Evidence and description are awaiting privacy review.
qrBody: This QR contains only the public report link.
flagged: Concern sent to the moderation queue.
rightsExplain: Use your private tracking credential or sign in as the owner. Public IDs alone cannot authorize data access.
requestComplete: Your request has been completed. Receipt:
confirmDelete: Delete this report's personal data and evidence? This cannot be undone.
myTitle: Your reports, from start to finish
myIntro: Reports saved on this device and reports linked to your account.
emptyMine: Your first report can make a difference.
emptyMineBody: When you report a suspected risk, you can follow its progress here.
learnTitle: A few minutes can make a difference.
learnIntro: Simple ways to reduce water accumulation around your home and neighborhood.
tip1Body: Check flowerpots, buckets and other water-holding containers regularly. Empty and scrub them when safe.
tip2Body: Keep water-storage containers covered and maintain drains so water can flow.
tip3Body: Remove discarded containers and waste that can hold rainwater. Ask the responsible team about unsafe sites.
tip4Body: Do not enter hazardous construction sites or private property. Share a photo from a safe place.
environmental: DengueSpot reports environmental conditions. It does not diagnose illness or confirm a mosquito species.
privacyIntro: You decide what to share. We keep precise locations and unreviewed evidence away from public view.
dataCollectedBody: A photo, category, location and accuracy, optional description, consent version and report history. If you sign in, we also link the report to your account.
publicDataBody: An opaque report ID, approximate area, category and status. Photos and descriptions are withheld until privacy review. Reporter identity and exact GPS are never public.
retentionBody: Draft policy: originals up to 30 days; exact location and reviewed evidence up to 180 days after closure; public reports up to two years. These are product targets subject to legal review and legal holds.
providersBody: AI, OCR, speech and SMS are disabled by default. Enabling a provider requires a separate data-processing review. No government integration is implied.
contactBody: Contact details must be configured before public launch.
loginBody: Demo access uses synthetic identities. Use the generated password from your local .env file.
loginError: Could not sign in. Check your demo password.
accessRequired: Sign in with the appropriate role to open this workspace.
authorityIntro: Review suspected conditions, coordinate teams and close the loop with evidence.
exactWarning: Jurisdiction-authorized access · This access is audited.
resolutionRequired: Add an after-photo and resolution note before resolving.
notePlaceholder: Add a concise reason for this action
aiDisabled: AI is disabled. Human review drives this workflow.
moderationIntro: Review privacy, spam and safety concerns. Release only evidence and text that are safe for public viewing.
footer: Built for community action in Bangladesh.
connection: You are offline. Drafts stay on this device.
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
source: All locations and reports are synthetic demonstration data.
notificationsBody: Open a report's timeline for the latest status. SMS notifications are not enabled.
unsafe: Do not approach unsafe sites. Report from a safe location.
mapHint: Select a marker to view a report
devicePrivacy: Draft photos and precise GPS are stored on this device until submitted or discarded. Avoid shared devices.
pinHelp: Click the map to adjust your private pin, or use the coordinate fields.
passwordHelp: Find DEMO_LOGIN_PASSWORD in the root .env file.
scanHelp: Take a photo of a report QR, choose an image, or paste its link.
qrLocalOnly: Your QR image is processed on this device and never uploaded.
qrScanFailed: No readable report QR found. Try a clearer image smaller than 8 MB.
invalidLink: Enter a valid local DengueSpot report link.
deleteDraftConfirm: Discard this draft and its photo from this device?
